name: agentmesh-suite
description: The 7-Service Microservice Runtime Mesh for AI Coding Agents.

symbol-graph.description: High-throughput AST symbol indexing, definition lookup, and cross-file call graphs.

sandbox-pool.description: Ephemeral copy-on-write workspace scratchpads, sub-second execution, snapshots & diffs.

test-oracle.description: Dynamic test impact analysis and automated git commit bisection.

ast-patcher.description: Deterministic AST-aware code transformation, refactoring, and atomic rollback.

episodic-memory.description: Semantic knowledge graph, episodic experience recording, and cross-session memory.

visual-eval.description: Headless browser DOM layout inspection, visual regression pixel-diffing & a11y audits.

safety-broker.description: Deny-by-default policy enforcement, secret vault proxying, and Merkle audit logs.
